subject: Re: Air freight quotes from MUC to SGN and ICN
body:
Thanks for your offer. We’re happy to go ahead with both shipments. Please book the first one now. We’ll confirm the second one later.

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer accepts the offer for both shipments and explicitly asks us to book the first one now.
